2026 Oakland County Land Sale Final Auction on Oct. 30, 2026
Oakland County tax-foreclosed properties are available for purchase only through an online auction. This year's final land sale auction will be held on Oct. 30, 2026, from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. Advance bidding and assistance are available to interested bidders without internet access.

Oakland County Treasurer's Office
Welcome to the Oakland County Treasurer's Office
Thank you for visiting our website!
As Oakland County Treasurer, I am unwavering in my commitment to help our residents, business owners, and communities continue to grow and thrive.
I believe public service is among the highest honors and privileges, and I am humbled by the trust and responsibility you have placed in me. I am a compassionate steward of our resources and believe we must be fiscally responsible and socially conscious to ensure all residents across our great county have access to the resources and assistance needed to prevent property tax foreclosure.
As Oakland County’s chief investment officer, the financial security of our county and our residents, and strengthening the viability of our businesses and communities are my top priorities. Every day my team and I will diligently work to safeguard taxpayer dollars, enhance property values, retain our AAA bond rating, and strengthen our neighborhoods and economy.
Read
As lifelong Oakland County residents, my wife and I are now raising our daughter and son here. I am committed to ensuring Oakland County continues to flourish for future generations.
Please explore our website for helpful information, to pay your taxes, or to sign up for our communications. I am always here to help, so feel free to contact me or our team at any time for assistance.
See you around the county,
Robert Wittenberg
Treasurer
